verdict.rationale: The axis applies because NY DOS publishes an online filing rail (supp-2, supp-3), but nothing in the pack describes the sign-in or account-verification path. There is no mention of credential MFA, biometrics, in-person proofing, or mailed PINs. The filing host reset the probe's connection (probe-4) and Business Express disallows crawling (probe-5), so no authentication flow was observed or documented.
